t: President Droupadi Murmu appointed Om Prakash Mathur, Governor of Sikkim, as Governor of Kerala (Keralam) in a gubernatorial reshuffle; outgoing Kerala Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar was moved to Tamil Nadu and Dushyant Gautam was named Governor of Sikkim.

The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (notified 23 October 2026) to include E100 (100% ethanol) alongside E85 as fuel for flex-fuel vehicles designed by manufacturers.

India hosted the 61st meeting of the International Committee of Legal Metrology (CIML), the governing body of the International Organization of Legal Metrology (OIML), in New Delhi from 26 October 2026 — the first time the meeting was held in India.

India's Aditya won gold in the men's 55 kg at the World Boxing U19 Championships in Budva, Montenegro, beating Russia's Islam Magomedov 4-1; India finished with four medals (1 gold, 1 silver, 2 bronze).

The Milwaukee Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 on 28 October 2026 to win the World Series, the first title in the franchise's history; catcher William Contreras was named World Series MVP.
